description: This file defines an enumeration 'LocalizedFormats' used for managing localized message formats in exception handling within the Apache Commons Math library. It includes constants for various error message templates and methods for retrieving localized strings based on locale.

classes.name: LocalizedFormats
classes.description: An enum implementing 'Localizable' that provides message format templates for exception messages, supporting localization.

methods.name: getSourceString
methods.description: Returns the original English message format string for the enum constant.

methods.name: getLocalizedString
methods.description: Retrieves the localized message string for the enum constant based on the provided Locale, falling back to the source string if no translation is available.
